name: Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition
description: Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition is a singleplayer and multiplayer isometric role-playing game, an enhanced edition of the first in the Icewind Dale series.

eax.problem: This is the Enhanced Edition, not the classic Icewind Dale, and it has no EAX.

notes: If you also own the classic Icewind Dale, it's a separate GOG purchase, 'Icewind Dale Complete', and that one has EAX.
